AC care through the year in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
Summers here are long and hot, and the monsoon brings damp air. A little care at the right time keeps your AC reliable.
Before the hot months
Book an AC service, wash the filters and make sure the outdoor unit has clear space around it. This is also the time to book installation, before everyone else does.
Peak summer
Wash the filters every few weeks. Do not ignore weak cooling, ice or dripping water: small faults grow fast when the AC runs all day.
Monsoon
Damp air makes drain blockages and musty smells more common. Running the AC in fan mode for a while can help dry the coil. If a smell stays, book a deep clean.
Winter, when the AC rests
Switch the AC off at the wall. Before the next season, get it serviced so you start the summer with a clean, tested AC.
Repair or replace? Our honest view
Usually worth repairing
One failed part: capacitor, fan motor, sensor, relay, belt, door seal
A leak at a joint
An appliance that was working well before this fault
Think before repairing
A new compressor on a very old AC or fridge
Worn drum bearings plus a failed board on an old washing machine
The same appliance failing again and again in different places

Why does an AC fail in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar?
Summers here are long and hot, so ACs run for many hours a day. Dust settles on filters and coils, drains clog, and capacitors and compressors work hard. A small fault ignored in March often becomes a full breakdown in May, when every technician is busy. If your AC cools weakly, drips, makes noise or trips, an early inspection usually costs less than waiting.

Split AC, window AC and inverter AC repair
Split ACs need both the indoor and outdoor units checked, including gas pressure and the outdoor fan and compressor. Window ACs often fail on the capacitor, fan motor or thermostat. Inverter ACs carry more electronics, so board and sensor faults are more common, and they need careful testing before any part is replaced. Our technicians work on all three types.
How does our AC repair visit work?
Call or WhatsApp us with the brand, the problem and your area.

You hear the fault in plain words and get the price before any work.
You approve, we repair, and we test the AC before leaving.
The repair is covered by our 120-day unconditional warranty.
Should I repair or replace my AC?
Repair makes sense when one part has failed and the AC is otherwise in good shape: a capacitor, fan motor, sensor, board or a leak at a joint. Replacement may be worth considering when an old AC needs a new compressor, or keeps failing in different places. We tell you honestly which is better for your AC and your budget. If the answer is repair, we quote it. We will not push a part you do not need.

AC Repair questions and answers
How much does AC repair cost in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar?
It depends on the fault, the parts and the AC type. A clean-up or capacitor change costs far less than a compressor or board. We inspect first and quote the price before any work starts.
Who provides AC repair near me in Aurangabad?
Urban Repair Company repairs ACs at your home across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) and nearby areas. Call +91 95798 68696 or message us on WhatsApp with your area.
Why is my AC running but not cooling?
Common causes are a dirty filter or coil, low gas from a leak, a weak capacitor, a failing compressor, or a faulty sensor or board. A technician needs to inspect the AC to confirm which.
Is same-day AC repair available in Aurangabad?
Yes. Same-day service is available. Call or WhatsApp us with your location and we will confirm the earliest slot.
Do you repair inverter ACs?
Yes. We repair inverter, split and window ACs. Inverter ACs have more electronics, so we test carefully before replacing any board or sensor.
Can you repair an AC that is still under manufacturer warranty?
If your AC is under the manufacturer's warranty, check with the manufacturer first, because using an outside technician can affect that warranty. For out-of-warranty ACs, we can repair it right away.
How long does an AC repair take?
Many faults are found on the first visit. The time depends on the fault and whether the part is available. The technician tells you after inspection.
Is it safe to keep running an AC that is not cooling?
It is better to switch it off. Running an AC with low gas or a failing compressor can cause more damage and a bigger repair bill.
Why is my AC leaking water inside the room?
Most often a blocked drain line, or a coil frozen from a dirty filter or low gas. The drain needs flushing and the cause of the freezing needs fixing.
What is the difference between AC repair and AC service?
Service is routine cleaning and checks that keep a working AC healthy. Repair fixes a fault such as poor cooling, leaks or noise. If your AC already has a problem, book a repair visit.
Do you repair ACs in shops and offices?
Yes. We repair split ACs in homes, shops and offices. Call us with the number of units and the problem.
Which areas of Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar do you cover?
We cover the whole city and nearby areas, including CIDCO, Garkheda, Jalna Road, Waluj, Beed Bypass, Cantonment and Osmanpura. Call to confirm your locality.

Why service your AC before summer?
An AC that has been idle for months collects dust on the filter and coil. Switch it on in the first hot week and it has to work harder to cool. A service before the season keeps cooling steady, helps you catch small faults, and avoids the rush when everyone books at once.
What does our AC service include?
Washing the filters and cleaning the indoor coil and blower
Checking and flushing the drain line
Cleaning the outdoor unit and checking the fan
Measuring gas pressure
Inspecting capacitors, wiring and connections
Testing the cooling at the end

AC service, deep cleaning or repair: which do you need?
SituationBest choice
AC works well, serviced yearlyNormal service
Musty smell or dirty waterDeep cleaning with a jet pump
Weak airflow even after a serviceDeep cleaning
Poor cooling with a clean ACRepair check for gas or electrical faults
Water dripping insideRepair visit: drain and coil check
How often should you service an AC?
At least once a year, ideally before summer. If your AC runs most of the day, you live in a dusty area, or you have pets, service it every six months. Between services, wash the filters every few weeks in heavy-use months.
Signs your AC needs a service now
Weak airflow or slow cooling
A musty smell when it starts
Water dripping from the indoor unit
A higher electricity bill than usual
Unusual noise from either unit

He checks gas pressure and the electrical parts.
He runs the AC and confirms the cooling.
You are told about any fault found, with the price, before any repair.
Split, window and inverter AC servicing

AC Service questions and answers
How often should an AC be serviced?
At least once a year, ideally before summer. Service every six months if the AC runs most of the day or the area is dusty.
How long does AC servicing take?
A routine service of one split AC usually takes around an hour, depending on the condition of the unit. We confirm timing when you book.
Who provides AC service near me in Aurangabad?
Urban Repair Company services ACs at your home across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) and nearby areas. Call +91 95798 68696.
What is the best time to service an AC?
Before the hot season starts, so you are not waiting when everyone books at once.
Does AC servicing include gas refilling?
No. Servicing checks the gas pressure. If gas is low there is a leak, which should be found and repaired before refilling. See our AC gas refilling page.
Can servicing fix weak cooling?
If dirt on the filter, coil or blower is the cause, yes. If the cause is low gas or a part fault, the AC needs a repair.
What is the difference between AC service and deep cleaning?
A normal service cleans the filters and checks the AC. Deep cleaning uses a jet pump to wash the coils and blower, and suits an AC that smells or has not been cleaned for years.
Do I need to service a new AC?
A new AC usually needs only filter washing in the first year. A full service helps after a season of heavy use or if the AC was installed in a dusty place.
Can I clean the AC filter myself?
Yes. Switch the AC off, wash the filter, dry it fully and refit it. Leave the coil and outdoor unit to a technician.
Does servicing reduce the electricity bill?
A clean coil and filter let the AC cool without extra strain, which can reduce power use.
Do you service window ACs?
Yes. We service window and split ACs of all major brands.
Which areas do you service ACs in?
We cover the whole city and nearby areas, including CIDCO, Garkheda, Jalna Road, Waluj and Osmanpura. Call to confirm.

Why installation quality matters
Most cooling, noise and leakage complaints in new ACs trace back to installation: a drain that slopes the wrong way, a loose outdoor stand, a pipe run that is too long, or poor insulation. A careful installation gives better cooling, a quieter AC and fewer repairs later.
What does a proper AC installation include?
Site check for the best indoor and outdoor positions
Mounting the indoor unit level on the wall
Fixing the outdoor unit securely on a stand or bracket
Connecting and insulating the copper pipes
Routing the drain with the correct slope
Electrical connections and a safe power supply check
Vacuuming the pipes and checking for leaks
A full test run and a walkthrough of the remote and settings

Split AC vs window AC installation
Split ACWindow AC
UnitsIndoor unit plus outdoor unitOne unit in a window or wall opening
NeedsWall space, pipe route, outdoor spotA strong frame and a proper opening
Noise indoorsUsually quieterUsually louder
Installation workMore: pipes, drain, outdoor standLess: frame, sealing, levelling
Good forBedrooms and living roomsSmall rooms and rented spaces
How do we install a split AC?
Inspect the wall, the outdoor position and the pipe route.
Drill the wall and fix the indoor mounting plate level.
Fix the outdoor unit securely.
Connect and insulate the pipes and route the drain.
Make the electrical connections.
Vacuum the system and check for leaks.
Run the AC, check cooling and drainage, and show you how to use it.
Choosing the right spot
Indoor unit: on a solid wall with clear airflow, away from direct heat sources, and within a short pipe distance of the outdoor unit.
Outdoor unit: in a ventilated place where hot air can escape, reachable for future servicing, and fixed securely.
Drain: a clear downward route so water can flow out.
How do we shift an AC to a new room or home?
We switch the AC off, safely collect the gas into the outdoor unit, remove both units, move them, and reinstall with fresh pipework where needed. We then vacuum, check for leaks and test the cooling. Tell us the old and new positions, and a photo of the new wall helps us quote.
Prepare before installation
Decide where the indoor and outdoor units will go.
Check that a suitable power point is available near the indoor unit.
Clear the wall and the floor below, and keep ladder access free.
Confirm you have permission for wall drilling and for the outdoor unit location, especially in flats.
Common installation mistakes to avoid
Very long pipe runs, which reduce cooling
An outdoor unit in a closed space where hot air gets trapped
A drain pipe that slopes the wrong way
Loose outdoor brackets that vibrate or sag
Skipping the vacuum and leak check

## AC Gas Refilling Aurangabad | Urban Repair Company
URL: https://theurbanrepaircompany.com/ac-gas-refill-chhatrapati-sambhajinagar

AC Gas Refilling in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad)
Quick answer: Urban Repair Company finds and repairs AC gas leaks, then refills and tests the gas in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad). AC gas is not used up like fuel, so low gas means a leak. We check first, repair the leak, vacuum the system and refill the correct refrigerant. Price quoted upfront, same-day service available, 120-day unconditional warranty. Call +91 95798 68696.
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar was known as Aurangabad until it was renamed, and people still use both names. Whichever you search for, our service area is the same: the whole city and nearby areas.
What is AC gas refilling?
An AC cools by moving refrigerant gas through a sealed loop of pipes and coils. That gas is not consumed. So if your AC is low on gas, it has leaked out somewhere, at a pipe joint, a valve or a coil. Simply topping up hides the problem for a few weeks, and the AC loses cooling again. We find the leak, fix it, and then refill.
Signs your AC is low on gas
What you noticeWhat it can meanWhat we do
Cooling gets weaker over weeksA slow gas leakLeak test, repair, refill
Ice on the copper pipe or the outdoor valveLow gas, so the coil gets too coldConfirm low gas and find the leak
Hissing or bubbling soundAn active leakIsolate and repair the leak
Oily residue on a pipe jointA leak at the jointRework the joint, vacuum, refill
AC runs non-stop without coolingLow gas, or another faultDiagnose before refilling
Need it fixed today?
Same-day service available. We inspect first and quote upfront.
Call +91 95798 68696Book on WhatsApp
Why a top-up alone is not enough
Refilling a leaking AC is like pumping a punctured tyre: it works for a while and then fails. Running an AC low on gas also strains the compressor, which is the most expensive part. We always find the cause first, so the fix lasts.
How do we refill AC gas?
Inspect the AC and check the gas pressure.
Test for leaks at the joints, valves and coils.
Repair the leak, for example by reworking the joint or replacing a faulty part.
Vacuum the system to remove air and moisture.
Refill the correct refrigerant to the right level.
Test the cooling and check pressures once more.
Which refrigerant does your AC use?
The type is printed on the label of the outdoor unit. Older ACs commonly use R22, and many newer ACs use R32 or R410A. Tell us the model when you call, and we will confirm. Never mix gases: each AC must be refilled with the type it was made for.

The AC type and capacity
The refrigerant used
Whether a leak repair or a new part is needed
How easy the units are to reach

Questions and answers
How much does AC gas refilling cost in Aurangabad?
It depends on the AC type, the refrigerant and whether a leak must be repaired first. We inspect, find the cause and quote before any work.
Does AC gas run out on its own?
No. AC gas is sealed in the system and is not used up. If it is low, there is a leak.
How often does an AC need gas?
A healthy AC should not need gas at all. If you need to refill it every season, there is a leak that should be repaired.
What are the signs of low AC gas?
Weak cooling, ice on the pipe or outdoor valve, a hissing sound, an oily pipe joint, or an AC that runs non-stop without cooling.
Can I run my AC with low gas?
It is better not to. Low gas strains the compressor and can lead to a much bigger repair.
How long does AC gas refilling take?
Checking and refilling usually takes a short visit. If a leak must be repaired, it takes longer. The technician tells you after inspection.
Is gas refilling part of an AC service?
No. A service checks the gas pressure. If gas is low, we repair the leak and refill as a separate job, with a quote first.
Which gas does my AC need: R22, R32 or R410A?
The refrigerant type is on the outdoor unit's label. Each AC must be refilled with its own type. Tell us the model and we will confirm.
Do you repair gas leaks?
Yes. We find the leak, repair it, vacuum the system and then refill.

Why planned maintenance works

What is AC deep cleaning?
A normal service cleans the filters and the surface of the coil. Deep cleaning goes further. The technician protects your surroundings, then washes the coil and blower with pressurised water from a jet pump, so built-up dust and grime wash out through the drain. The outdoor coil is washed too.
Normal service or deep cleaning?
SituationBest choice
AC serviced every year and working wellNormal service
Musty smell or dirty water drippingDeep cleaning
Weak airflow even after a serviceDeep cleaning
AC not cleaned for several yearsDeep cleaning
Poor cooling with a clean ACA repair check for gas or electrical faults
Need it fixed today?
Same-day service available. We inspect first and quote upfront.
Call +91 95798 68696Book on WhatsApp
How do we deep clean an AC?
Cover the furniture and floor, and fit a water-collection sheet to the indoor unit.
Switch off the power and protect the electrical parts.
Wash the coil and blower with the jet pump.
Clean the drain tray, drain line and filters.
Wash the outdoor coil.
Reassemble, switch on, and test the cooling and the drain.
Signs your AC needs a deep clean
A musty or damp smell when it starts
Dirty or brown water from the drain
Weak airflow that a normal service did not fix
Visible dust or mould on the vanes
It has been several years since the last proper clean
After a deep clean
Airflow and cooling should improve if dirt was the cause. Wash the filters every few weeks, and keep the outdoor unit clear. If cooling is still weak, the problem is likely gas or a part, and the AC needs a repair visit.

How often should I deep clean my AC?

Common washing machine problems and fixes
What you noticeLikely causeWhat we do
Not drainingBlocked hose or filter, failed drain pumpClear the blockage, replace the pump if needed
Not spinningWorn belt or motor, door or lid switch, load imbalanceTest belt, motor and switch, then repair

Error codes: what they usually mean
Codes differ by brand, but most point to one of a few areas: a drain problem (water not leaving the drum), a door or lid lock problem, a water inlet problem, or an unbalanced load. Check your manual for the code. If clearing the filter and rebalancing the load do not fix it, call us with the code and the model.
Need it fixed today?

Call +91 95798 68696Book on WhatsApp
Front-load vs top-load: typical faults
Front-load machines often have door seal leaks, drain filter blockages, bearing noise and door lock faults. Top-load machines more often have belt and motor problems, lid switch faults, suspension wear and imbalance. We repair both, and we can tell you which faults are typical for your machine.
What you can check before calling
Unplug the machine.
Check the drain hose for kinks, and the inlet hose and tap.
Clean the drain filter if your model has one, with a towel ready.
Redistribute a heavy or bunched load.
Plug in and run a rinse or spin cycle.
If it still fails, note any error code and call us.

Repair or replace your washing machine?
Most faults, such as a blocked pump, a worn belt, a door lock or a leaking seal, are worth repairing. A very old machine with worn bearings or a failed control board may cost close to the value of the machine. We tell you honestly before you decide.

Washing Machine Repair questions and answers
How much does washing machine repair cost in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar?
It depends on the fault, the parts and the machine. A cleared drain or a belt costs far less than a motor or control board. We inspect first and quote before any work.
Who repairs washing machines near me in Aurangabad?
Urban Repair Company repairs front-load and top-load washing machines at your home across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad). Call +91 95798 68696.
Why is my washing machine not draining?
Common causes are a blocked drain hose or filter, a failed drain pump or a control fault. Unplug it and check the hose and the drain filter first.
Why is my washing machine not spinning?
A worn belt or motor, a faulty door or lid switch, or an unbalanced load can stop the spin. Rebalance the load first. If it still fails, it needs a technician.
Why does my washing machine shake or move?
The machine may be unlevel, overloaded or unbalanced, or its suspension or shock absorbers may be worn. Level it and redistribute the load. If it continues, call us.
Why is water leaking from my washing machine?
Common causes are a worn door seal, a loose or cracked hose, or a pump seal. We find the source and replace the part.
Why does my washing machine smell?
Damp detergent residue builds up in the drum and seal. Leave the door open after washes and run a drum clean. If the smell stays, a drain blockage may be the cause.
What does an error code on my washing machine mean?
Codes differ by brand, but most point to drain, door lock, water inlet or load balance problems. Check your manual, and call us with the code and model if it does not clear.
Do you repair both front-load and top-load machines?
Yes. We repair front-load and top-load machines of all major brands. Call us about any other type.
How long does a washing machine repair take?
Many faults are found on the first visit. The time depends on the fault and whether the part is available. The technician tells you after inspection.

Frost-free vs direct-cool: what goes wrong
Direct-cool fridges need manual defrosting and often develop frost, thermostat and door seal problems. Frost-free fridges use a defrost heater, a timer or board and an evaporator fan, so a fault in any of these can leave the fridge section warm while the freezer still works. We diagnose which system has failed before replacing parts.
How do you know if it is the compressor?
A compressor problem often shows as a fridge that clicks and stops, hums without cooling, or runs without getting cold. These signs can also come from a faulty start relay or a gas leak, which cost much less to fix. A technician tests the compressor and the relay before saying a compressor is at fault.

Keep the door closed as much as possible.

Do not refreeze food that has fully thawed.
Tell us if the fridge has been warm for several hours.
Repair or replace your refrigerator?
Most refrigerator faults, such as a relay, a fan, a thermostat, a defrost part or a door seal, are worth repairing. A compressor replacement on an old refrigerator needs a decision. We give you an honest view and the price for each option.

Is it worth repairing a refrigerator compressor?
It depends on the age of the fridge and the repair cost. We test first, because many cooling problems come from a relay, a fan or a gas leak instead. We give you an honest view before you decide.
Does a refrigerator need gas refilling?
A refrigerator uses sealed gas and does not use it up. If it is low there is a leak, which has to be repaired before refilling.
Why is my fridge warm but my freezer cold?
This often points to an evaporator fan or defrost problem that stops cold air reaching the fridge section. It needs a technician.
Why is there ice build-up in my refrigerator?
Common causes are a worn door seal, a door left open, or a defrost heater or sensor fault. We find the cause and repair it.
Why is water collecting under my refrigerator?
A blocked defrost drain or a cracked drain tray is the usual cause. Clearing or replacing it fixes the leak.
Why is my refrigerator making a loud noise?
Rattling often means loose parts or an uneven floor. Buzzing can mean a failing fan motor or compressor strain. If it is new or loud, have it checked.
Do you repair double-door and side-by-side refrigerators?
Yes. We repair single-door, double-door, side-by-side and inverter refrigerators.
How long can food stay in a warm fridge?
Move perishable food to a cooler place if the fridge stays warm for a few hours. Do not refreeze food that has fully thawed.

Fridge Repair in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad)

Fridge problems and what to do
Fridge not cooling
Check that it is plugged in, the thermostat is not set warm, and the door seals fully. If it is still warm after a few hours, the cause is often a relay, a fan, a gas leak or a compressor fault.
Freezer not freezing
Look for frost on the back wall and listen for the fan. A defrost fault or thermostat problem is common. Call us if the freezer stays soft.
Fridge too cold or freezing food
The thermostat may be set too cold, or the thermostat or sensor may have failed. Turn the dial down. If food still freezes, it needs a technician.
Water leaking under the fridge
A blocked defrost drain is the usual cause. A cracked tray or a damaged water line can also leak.
Fridge making noise
A low hum is normal. Rattling suggests loose parts or an uneven floor, buzzing suggests a fan motor, and repeated clicking suggests a start relay.
Door not sealing or closing
A worn gasket or a misaligned door lets warm air in and builds frost. Replacing the gasket often fixes it.
Light or display not working
This is usually a bulb, a switch or a board connection. We test and replace the part.
Bad smell
Spoiled food, a blocked drain or a damp drain tray is the usual cause. Clean the fridge, and call us if the smell stays.

Fridge Repair questions and answers
Why is my fridge not cooling but the light is on?
The light only needs power. Cooling can fail because of a relay, a compressor, a fan, a gas leak or a thermostat fault. A technician has to test which.
How much does fridge repair cost in Aurangabad?
It depends on the symptom and the part that failed. We inspect first and quote the price before any work starts.
Can I fix a fridge door seal myself?
You can clean a dirty seal with warm water. A torn or hardened seal needs replacing, and a technician can fit the right one.
Why does my fridge freeze everything?
The thermostat may be set too cold or may have failed, or a sensor may be faulty. Turn the dial down first.
Is it normal for a fridge to make noise?
A low hum and occasional clicks are normal. Loud buzzing, rattling or repeated clicking are not.
Why is my freezer full of ice?
A worn door seal, a door left open, or a defrost fault is the usual cause. The cause has to be fixed or the ice returns.

What is the difference between AC repair and AC service?

AC servicing
How often should an AC be serviced?

What is the best time to service an AC?
Before the hot season starts, so you are not waiting when everyone books at once.
Does AC servicing include gas refilling?
No. Servicing checks the gas pressure. If gas is low there is a leak, which should be found and repaired before refilling. See our AC gas refilling page.
Can servicing fix weak cooling?
If dirt on the filter, coil or blower is the cause, yes. If the cause is low gas or a part fault, the AC needs a repair.
What is the difference between AC service and deep cleaning?
A normal service cleans the filters and checks the AC. Deep cleaning uses a jet pump to wash the coils and blower, and suits an AC that smells or has not been cleaned for years.
Do I need to service a new AC?
A new AC usually needs only filter washing in the first year. A full service helps after a season of heavy use or if the AC was installed in a dusty place.
Can I clean the AC filter myself?
Yes. Switch the AC off, wash the filter, dry it fully and refit it. Leave the coil and outdoor unit to a technician.
Does servicing reduce the electricity bill?
A clean coil and filter let the AC cool without extra strain, which can reduce power use.
Do you service window ACs?
Yes. We service window and split ACs of all major brands.
Which areas do you service ACs in?
We cover the whole city and nearby areas, including CIDCO, Garkheda, Jalna Road, Waluj and Osmanpura. Call to confirm.
AC gas refilling
How much does AC gas refilling cost in Aurangabad?
It depends on the AC type, the refrigerant and whether a leak must be repaired first. We inspect, find the cause and quote before any work.
Does AC gas run out on its own?
No. AC gas is sealed in the system and is not used up. If it is low, there is a leak.
How often does an AC need gas?
A healthy AC should not need gas at all. If you need to refill it every season, there is a leak that should be repaired.
What are the signs of low AC gas?
Weak cooling, ice on the pipe or outdoor valve, a hissing sound, an oily pipe joint, or an AC that runs non-stop without cooling.
Can I run my AC with low gas?
It is better not to. Low gas strains the compressor and can lead to a much bigger repair.
How long does AC gas refilling take?
Checking and refilling usually takes a short visit. If a leak must be repaired, it takes longer. The technician tells you after inspection.
Is gas refilling part of an AC service?
No. A service checks the gas pressure. If gas is low, we repair the leak and refill as a separate job, with a quote first.
Which gas does my AC need: R22, R32 or R410A?
The refrigerant type is on the outdoor unit's label. Each AC must be refilled with its own type. Tell us the model and we will confirm.
Do you repair gas leaks?
Yes. We find the leak, repair it, vacuum the system and then refill.
Who does AC gas refilling near me in Aurangabad?
Urban Repair Company does AC gas refilling at your home across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad). Call +91 95798 68696.
Is there a warranty on gas refilling?
Yes. Our work carries a 120-day unconditional warranty.
AC maintenance and deep cleaning
What is included in AC maintenance?
Cleaning the filters, coils, blower and outdoor unit, checking the drain, gas pressure and electrical parts, and testing the cooling.
How often should a shop or office AC be maintained?
ACs that run all day benefit from visits before summer and again before or after the peak season. We suggest a schedule once we know how much they run.
Is AC maintenance different from AC service?
A service is a single visit. Maintenance is a planned series of visits that keeps your ACs in good shape across the year.
Can you maintain many ACs in one visit?
Yes. Tell us the number and types of ACs and we plan the visit and quote it together.
Do you maintain ACs in offices and clinics?
Yes. We work in homes, shops, offices and clinics.
What if you find a fault during maintenance?
You hear the fault and the price before any repair. We repair only after you approve.
Does maintenance prevent breakdowns?
It cannot prevent every fault, but regular cleaning and checks catch many problems early, before they cause a breakdown.
Who provides AC maintenance near me in Aurangabad?
Urban Repair Company provides AC maintenance across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) and nearby areas. Call +91 95798 68696.
Is there a warranty on maintenance work?
Yes. Our work carries a 120-day unconditional warranty.
What is the difference between AC deep cleaning and a normal service?
A normal service cleans the filters and checks the AC. Deep cleaning washes the coils and blower with a jet pump to remove built-up dirt.
How often should I deep clean my AC?
Not every visit. Once every year or two is usually enough, or when there is a smell or weak airflow.
Is jet pump cleaning safe for my AC?
Done properly, with the electrical parts covered and the power off, it is a standard method.
Will deep cleaning fix poor cooling?
If dirt on the coil or blower is the cause, yes. If the cause is a gas leak or a part fault, it needs repair.
How long does AC deep cleaning take?
It takes longer than a normal service. The technician gives you an idea when he sees the AC.
Does deep cleaning remove bad smells?
It removes the damp dirt that causes most smells. If a smell stays, the drain may need more work.
Do you deep clean window ACs?
Yes. We deep clean split and window ACs.
Is there mess during deep cleaning?
We cover the surroundings and collect the water, and we clean up afterwards.

Yes. Our work carries a 120-day unconditional warranty.
Washing machine repair
How much does washing machine repair cost in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar?
It depends on the fault, the parts and the machine. A cleared drain or a belt costs far less than a motor or control board. We inspect first and quote before any work.
Who repairs washing machines near me in Aurangabad?
Urban Repair Company repairs front-load and top-load washing machines at your home across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad). Call +91 95798 68696.
Why is my washing machine not draining?
Common causes are a blocked drain hose or filter, a failed drain pump or a control fault. Unplug it and check the hose and the drain filter first.
Why is my washing machine not spinning?
A worn belt or motor, a faulty door or lid switch, or an unbalanced load can stop the spin. Rebalance the load first. If it still fails, it needs a technician.
Why does my washing machine shake or move?
The machine may be unlevel, overloaded or unbalanced, or its suspension or shock absorbers may be worn. Level it and redistribute the load. If it continues, call us.
Why is water leaking from my washing machine?
Common causes are a worn door seal, a loose or cracked hose, or a pump seal. We find the source and replace the part.
Why does my washing machine smell?
Damp detergent residue builds up in the drum and seal. Leave the door open after washes and run a drum clean. If the smell stays, a drain blockage may be the cause.
What does an error code on my washing machine mean?
Codes differ by brand, but most point to drain, door lock, water inlet or load balance problems. Check your manual, and call us with the code and model if it does not clear.
Do you repair both front-load and top-load machines?
Yes. We repair front-load and top-load machines of all major brands. Call us about any other type.
How long does a washing machine repair take?
Many faults are found on the first visit. The time depends on the fault and whether the part is available. The technician tells you after inspection.
Is same-day washing machine repair available?
Yes. Same-day service is available. Call or WhatsApp us and we confirm the earliest slot for your area.
Does the repair come with a warranty?
Yes. Repairs carry a 120-day unconditional warranty, and we use genuine spare parts.
Refrigerator and fridge repair
How much does refrigerator repair cost in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar?
It depends on the fault, the parts and the fridge type. A relay or door seal costs far less than a compressor or board. We inspect first and quote before any work.
Who repairs refrigerators near me in Aurangabad?
Urban Repair Company repairs refrigerators at your home across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad). Call +91 95798 68696.
Is it worth repairing a refrigerator compressor?
It depends on the age of the fridge and the repair cost. We test first, because many cooling problems come from a relay, a fan or a gas leak instead. We give you an honest view before you decide.
Does a refrigerator need gas refilling?
A refrigerator uses sealed gas and does not use it up. If it is low there is a leak, which has to be repaired before refilling.
Why is my fridge warm but my freezer cold?
This often points to an evaporator fan or defrost problem that stops cold air reaching the fridge section. It needs a technician.
Why is there ice build-up in my refrigerator?
Common causes are a worn door seal, a door left open, or a defrost heater or sensor fault. We find the cause and repair it.
Why is water collecting under my refrigerator?
A blocked defrost drain or a cracked drain tray is the usual cause. Clearing or replacing it fixes the leak.
Why is my refrigerator making a loud noise?
Rattling often means loose parts or an uneven floor. Buzzing can mean a failing fan motor or compressor strain. If it is new or loud, have it checked.
Do you repair double-door and side-by-side refrigerators?
Yes. We repair single-door, double-door, side-by-side and inverter refrigerators.
How long can food stay in a warm fridge?
Move perishable food to a cooler place if the fridge stays warm for a few hours. Do not refreeze food that has fully thawed.
Is same-day refrigerator repair available?
Yes. Same-day service is available. Call or WhatsApp us and we confirm the earliest slot.
Why is my fridge not cooling but the light is on?
The light only needs power. Cooling can fail because of a relay, a compressor, a fan, a gas leak or a thermostat fault. A technician has to test which.
How much does fridge repair cost in Aurangabad?
It depends on the symptom and the part that failed. We inspect first and quote the price before any work starts.
Can I fix a fridge door seal myself?
You can clean a dirty seal with warm water. A torn or hardened seal needs replacing, and a technician can fit the right one.
Why does my fridge freeze everything?
The thermostat may be set too cold or may have failed, or a sensor may be faulty. Turn the dial down first.
Is it normal for a fridge to make noise?
A low hum and occasional clicks are normal. Loud buzzing, rattling or repeated clicking are not.
Why is my freezer full of ice?
A worn door seal, a door left open, or a defrost fault is the usual cause. The cause has to be fixed or the ice returns.
Do you repair fridges at home?
Yes. Our technicians come to your home across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) and nearby areas.

Yes. We repair all major brands, including LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, Godrej, Haier, Bosch and Hitachi.

Yes. Repairs carry a 120-day unconditional warranty, and we use genuine spare parts.

ServiceWhat changes the price
AC repairThe fault, the parts needed, and the AC type and capacity

Why we inspect before quoting
A price given without seeing the appliance is a guess. A fridge that is not cooling could need a ten-minute fix or a new compressor. A washing machine that will not drain could have a blocked hose or a failed pump. By inspecting first, we tell you the real price for the real fault.

Share any error code you can see.

Service your AC every year, before summer.

Keep fridge coils and washing machine filters clean.
